Analista de Governança Microsoft - Pleno / Sênior

Missão

Atuar como referência de governança e sustentação técnica (nível N3) para o ecossistema Microsoft, garantindo estabilidade, segurança, conformidade e controle de custos principalmente em Power Platform, SharePoint Online e Copilot Studio. A posição combina administração de plataforma com capacidade prática de construção e troubleshooting de soluções low‑code e agentes.

A administração e governança desses produtos é centralizada nos centros de administração (Power Platform Admin Center etc.) e envolve proteger dados, controlar acessos e monitorar o que makers/usuários fazem.

Escopo de atuação

Microsoft (Power Platform, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, M365/Entra, Copilot Studio)

Administração pontual / governança leve de plataformas de IA corporativa (Gemini Enterprise, OpenAI Enterprise, NotebookLM) (ex.: gestão de acessos, onboarding, padrões e controles básicos)

Requisitos

  • 1) Administração e Sustentação da Plataforma (N3)

    Administrar ambientes (criação, padronização, saneamento, controle de capacidade e permissões), garantindo operação estável e previsível.

    Executar rotinas de manutenção, saneamento e ajustes técnicos (ex.: ambientes órfãos, owners, conectores, políticas, agentes e automações fora de padrão).

    Definir e manter runbooks e procedimentos operacionais para incidentes recorrentes e auditorias.

  • 2) Governança e Segurança (Power Platform + Copilot Studio + M365)

    Implementar e operar políticas de governança: DLP, segmentação de conectores (Business/Non-Business), padrões de ambientes e critérios de publicação.

    Garantir aderência a controles de Copilot Studio (ex.: data policies, autenticação, conectores/ações, roteamento de ambientes, logs e rastreabilidade).

  • 3) Desenvolvimento e Troubleshooting (N3 Maker) – obrigatório

    Desenvolver e dar suporte avançado (N3) em: Agentes no Copilot Studio (conectores, knowledge sources, autenticação, governança de publicação e segurança).

    Power Apps (Canvas e/ou Model‑driven conforme necessidade) e Power Automate (cloud flows, integrações e automações administrativas).

    Diagnosticar incidentes complexos de makers/ambientes (erros de permissão, conectores, falhas de execução, limites/capacidade, problemas de DLP e ALM).

  • 4) Administração do Dataverse (capacidade, saúde e KPIs)

    Administrar o Dataverse garantindo utilização dentro de KPIs (capacidade, performance, organização e governança do inventário).

    Monitorar e corrigir causas de degradação (crescimento descontrolado, ambientes mal configurados, automações etc.).

    Apoiar governança de dados/entidades relevantes ao CoE e relatórios operacionais.

  • 5) Gestão de custos e sustentabilidade financeira

    Controlar e reportar custos e consumo de: Power Apps / Power Automate, Copilot Studio (agentes).

    Propor medidas de otimização (racionalização de ambientes, consolidação/arquivamento, revisão de owners/licenças, desativação de ativos sem uso, melhoria de governança de conectores).

  • 6) Operação do CoE (Power Platform + Copilot Studio)

    Administrar e evoluir o Centro de Excelência (CoE): inventário, auditoria operacional, padrões, dashboards e rotinas automatizadas de governança.

    Monitorar automações administrativas do CoE e garantir execução/observabilidade.

    Suportar a organização com orientações de governança e boas práticas (makers, owners, champions e times low‑code).

  • 7) SharePoint Online (governança e sustentação)

    Atuar em governança de SharePoint Online (estrutura, acessos, padrões de armazenamento, higiene/organização e integração com soluções Power Platform/Copilot).

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prática com administração e governança do Power Platform (ambientes, DLP, conectores, capacidade, troubleshooting).
  • Conhecimento sólido de licenciamento e segurança no ecossistema Power Platform + M365.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver: Agentes no Copilot Studio (incluindo conectores/ações e governança).
  • Power Apps e Power Automate (para ser N3 de desenvolvimento e plataforma).
  • Vivência com Dataverse (administração, organização e sustentação operacional).
  • Experiência com SharePoint Online (admin/governança básica a intermediária e integrações).

Diferenciais (nice to have)

title: Product Specialist - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Job Description

Biocomposites is an international medical devices company that engineers, manufactures, and markets world leading products for use in infection management in bone and soft tissue. Based in Keele, UK, it has global operations across Europe, USA, Argentina, Canada, China, and India. Biocomposites is a world leader in the development of innovative calcium compounds and bone cements for surgical use. Its products regenerate bone and target infection risks across a variety of specialties, including musculoskeletal infection, orthopaedics, trauma, spine, foot and ankle, podiatry, and sports injuries. Biocomposites products are now used in over one million procedures per annum and sold in more than 100 countries around the world.

The Role

The Biocomposites Product Specialist’s primary goal is to drive compliant sales growth of the Biocomposites’ product portfolio across our core specialties of orthopedics, trauma, spine, and foot and ankle in priority target accounts. This will be achieved by motivating, educating and supporting the appropriate distributor sales representatives in their sales activities including product training, hospital and surgeon target selection and hands‑on, in‑field sales support. It will also include regularly travelling to target hospitals to engage with surgeons, peri‑operative teams, and hospital staff directly to promote correct product use and adoption. The position reports directly to the Country Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Achieve sales revenue targets by product and specialty in assigned Region.
  • Drive adoption in existing accounts and new users in hospitals within assigned territory. This will be achieved by directly selling to targeted surgeons as well as educating, supporting, and selling through local distribution teams.
  • Exhibit confidence in product knowledge and science to handle competitive threats.
  • Leverage data and local insight to prioritize local territory needs and activities.
  • Utilize business planning tools, data and information to effectively work the territory while achieving goals through set quarterly MBOs.
  • Enhance relationships with key stakeholders within distributor network to influence resource allocation and prioritize focus on Biocomposites’ products.
  • Ensure all distributor sales representatives sell compliantly and use our approved product messaging.
  • Provide continuous training and education to all distributor sales representatives in all vertical markets.
  • Identify and engage new distribution partners in our key vertical markets.
  • Regularly update distributor network on market conditions, challenges, product innovations, competition and pricing, as directed by Region Sales Manager.
  • Provide surgeon product feedback and identify surgeon challenges and opportunities to inform new product development.
  • Demonstrate OR and product competency to assist surgeons and peri‑operative team with technical guidance.
  • Routinely assist distribution with product expertise and support during sales calls.
  • Provide product in‑services and continuing education seminars to hospital staff.
  • Cultivate relationships with key surgeons, residents, fellows and KOL’s, within geography.
  • Support local customer dinner meetings and scientific exchanges.
  • Support Region Sales Manager in business planning.
  • Achieve quarterly territory Objectives as directed by Region Sales Manager.
  • Clinician and Distributor continuing education via sales trainings, current medical journals and clinical papers.
  • Timely and accurate expense reporting by way of Concur.
  • Ability to travel and conduct overnight stays within the geography as needed.
  • Ability to travel to US headquarters in Wilmington, NC for business meetings as needed.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of documented medical or B2B sales success grounded in sales process training.
  • Advanced level of English.
  • Documented sales success and career progression.
  • Demonstration of competency in presenting technical information.
  • Ability to work with highly diverse groups.
  • Ability to present and educate provided materials.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Documented ability to influence decision makers.
  • Medical Device/Orthopedics Industry experience.
  • Basic knowledge of human anatomy is preferred.
  • Understanding of Hospital OR policy and procedures preferred.
  • Highly organized with exceptional follow‑up.
  • Computer skills, CRM skills, and ability to utilize technology to aid in Territory Management.
  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Resides within the geographical territory.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle.
  • Background check and drug screening.

What do we offer?

Competitive salary and benefits! With us, you will receive a competitive salary package and benefits.

We grow talent. At Biocomposites we create opportunities to thrive and grow.

One Biocomposites - team spirit & engagement. Our culture is important, and we strive to create engaged and inclusive global teams that encourage colleagues to share their diverse perspectives and opinions.

Who do we look for?

People Who Are Passionate About What We Do.

People who are open minded to evolving the way we work.

People who can work together to transform outcomes and change lives.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Vibe Code specialist, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing various tools such as our provided Apify and OpenRouter alongside your own resourceful approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end‑to‑end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.

  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross‑source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $17 per hour equivalent , depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects that match your technical skills, on your own schedule. From coding and automation to fine‑tuning AI outputs, you'll play a key role in advancing AI capabilities and real‑world applications.

  • Python web scraping: Build reliable scraping scripts using BeautifulSoup, Selenium (or equivalents) for multi‑level sites, dynamic JS content (infinite scroll, AJAX), and API endpoints via provided proxy.
  • Data extraction expertise: Navigate complex hierarchical structures (regions → companies → details), handling archived pages and varied HTML formats.
  • Data processing: Clean, normalize, and validate scraped data; deliver high‑quality datasets in well‑structured formats (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets) with clear, consistent presentation.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem‑solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Self‑directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper‑intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands‑on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.

title: Care Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Functions

To provide coordination of client-centered services that link clients with substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health with coordinated care and psychosocial services.

Working closely and collaboratively with the HUH inpatient and Consultation-Liaison and Addiction Medicine Consult services and the ambulatory Mental Health Clinic (Behavioral Health Clinic) teams, the Care Coordinator assesses clients’ needs and support systems; facilitates timely, coordinated access to and continuation of medically appropriate substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health care health and support services; assists in expediting appropriate discharge from inpatient facilities, as medically appropriate, and assists in preventing unnecessary hospitalizations; and establishes and maintains relations with case managers, healthcare providers, social services and other agency representatives to bridge the gaps between health, social service, entitlements and other systems.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assists in development and implements protocols for coordinating the substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health services for individual clients or patients with substance use or co-occurring psychiatric and substance use disorders.
  • Provides care coordination services to a caseload of patients/clients, as assigned by the PI, Project Director, or Care Manager Coordinator.
  • Operates as a liaison between the Departments of Psychiatry and Community and Family Medicine, Social Work and the DC Department of Health and other community groups.
  • Ensures that patients receive necessary follow-up substance use or psychiatric disorder treatment and medical treatments.
  • May accompany patients to the initial or follow-up visits and may help arrange transportation and scheduling of appointments.
  • Conducts intake and follow up assessments of clients’/patients’ behavioral health and medical/functional status; structural vulnerabilities; psychological; educational; financial; and individual support needs.
  • Reviews all initial client bio-psychosocial assessments and reassessments.
  • Attends department trainings and meetings relevant in ongoing effort to increase knowledge and skills to work effectively with clients.Attends annual and mandatory compliance Program training, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy training, maintains adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Works on behalf of patients receiving medications for opioid use disorder treatment to improve the system of care by identifying service gaps and identifying services that are needed and ensuring that these services are provided in a courteous and dignified manner.
  • Maintains confidentiality of patients, their families and the staff.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of the care needed for individuals receiving MOUD or other substance use disorder treatment.
  • Knowledge of community resources to establish referral systems with community agencies to facilitate coordinated management plans for patients and their families.
  • Ability to express ideas clearly using appropriate language in communicating with a wide range of health, socioeconomic, and cultural groups.
  • Competence in both oral and written English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with clients and their family members and other treatment or service providers; physicians, staff, University and Hospital personnel, and the general public.
  • Proficiency in both oral and written English.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field, or 2 or more years of experience in the field.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$46,700 - $52,700

description:
Descrição

Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D’Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D’Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.

Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.

A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.

Requisitos

  • Curso Superior Completo;
  • Competência em Ferramentas de Pesquisa Digital.
  • Habilidade em Redação e Produção de Conteúdo e apresentações.

description:
A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

A área de Customer Experience da Leve Saúde atua de forma estratégica na melhoria contínua da jornada do beneficiário, conectando dados, operação e transformação.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Processos e Projetos Pleno para atuar no time de Customer Experience (CX), sendo responsável por conduzir iniciativas de melhoria da jornada do cliente, com foco em gerar impacto real para o cliente e para o negócio.

Procuramos uma pessoa com perfil mão na massa, organizado e protagonista , que tenha autonomia para conduzir projetos, navegar entre áreas e transformar problemas em soluções práticas.

A Leve é uma empresa em crescimento acelerado, por isso, mais do que seguir um escopo rígido, esperamos alguém disposto a construir, adaptar e evoluir junto com a área , com potencial para assumir desafios cada vez mais complexos ao longo do tempo.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir projetos estruturantes de melhoria da jornada do cliente, do diagnóstico à implementação;
  • Gerenciar iniciativas utilizando metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban e etc),incluindo gestão de backlog e priorização a partir de metodologia;
  • Traduzir dados e insights da Voz do Cliente em planos de ação estruturados;
  • Apoiar na gestão de mudanças, reduzindo o impacto no cliente e garantindo a adoção das melhorias pelas áreas envolvidas;
  • Mapear e redesenhar processos e jornadas do cliente, identificando oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Conduzir workshops e rituais de projetos (brainstorming, planning, sprint e reviews);
  • Articular com diferentes áreas (operação, rede, relacionamento, tecnologia, etc.) para garantir a execução e sucesso das entregas;
  • Elaborar materiais com storytelling claro e objetivo, evidenciando resultados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores e garantir a mensuração dos resultados das iniciativas implementadas;
  • Utilizar ferramentas, incluindo inteligência artificial, para otimizar análises, organização e execução das atividades.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos, Processos, Tecnologia, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e melhoria de processos;
  • Vivência na gestão de squads, aplicação de metodologias ágeis e condução de projetos multidisciplinares;
  • Forte capacidade de planejamento, organização, gestão de riscos, acompanhamento de cronogramas e comunicação com stakeholders diversos;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e apoiar na geração de insights;
  • Conhecimento em mapeamento e redesenho de processos/jornadas;
  • Habilidade de construção de materiais executivos com storytelling;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Pacote Google, Office, Jira, Bizagi e Miro.

  • Familiaridade com uso de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia de trabalho;
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital, automação dE processos ou implantação de tecnologias.

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Operations FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager will work closely with the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure the planning, implementation, and delivery of the ticketing operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. This role will be responsible for managing the ticketing operations at the stadiums and all ticketing facilities in the host country. Further, this role will oversee the creation and maintenance of seating maps in the ticketing system, as well as the assignment of ticket holders to seats in accordance with FIFA policies.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the Ticketing Operations team in Brazil in the overall tournament planning, ensuring the team has the guidance, resources, and support required to deliver their roles successfully.
  • Foster strong collaboration within the local team and with the Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure consistent operational alignment.
  • Implement system configuration according to the specifications set by the Zurich team, maintaining accuracy and consistency across all platforms.
  • Oversee and manage the ticketing inventory, including the creation, maintenance, and continuous updating of seating plans for all host venues in the ticketing system.
  • Plan, prepare, and supervise the full on‑site ticketing operation, including the setup and management of all required infrastructure and equipment.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain ticketing policies and procedures to ensure operational excellence and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination with other functional areas as well as the host stadium to support a seamless event delivery.
  • Oversee all electronic access control operations in the host venues, ensuring proper configuration, integration, and match‑day readiness.
  • Plan, schedule, and conduct site visits as required to assess operational needs, validate infrastructure, and coordinate with venue stakeholders.
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events as required.

Your profile

Education / Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in ticketing operations for major sports events, venues, or entertainment properties.
  • Experience delivering ticketing operations for multi-venue events or international tournaments is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms and access control technologies.
  • Strong operational planning and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced event environment with multiple deadlines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Leadership and team management
  • Operational planning and execution
  • Stakeholder management
  • Problem solving and decision making
  • Communication and coordination
  • Attention to detail
  • Risk management mindset

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. THE POSITION

Under the guidance of the FIFA Refereeing (Zurich) and Team Services (FIFA27), the Referee Operations Manager will lead the planning and delivery of all referee operations during FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ and related refereeing events. The role is to ensure the excellence of all services required for match officials, fully aligned with FIFA’s Refereeing Requirements, and to guarantee seamless coordination between FIFA Refereeing, Local Team Services and all relevant functional areas. The Referee Operations Manager will be based in the FIFA 27 headquarters in Rio de Janeiro during the planning stage and at the Referee Base Camp during tournament time.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure that all operational plans, services, logistics and procedures for Referee Services fully comply with FIFA Refereeing Requirements, delivering the highest standards of service quality to match officials.
  • Operationalise technical and operational needs from FIFA Refereeing into practical, efficient and integrated operational solutions.
  • Lead cross‑functional coordination with all relevant functional areas (FAs) to ensure full integration of Referee Services into tournament operations.
  • Represent Referee Services in operational meetings, workshops, and multi‑stakeholder sessions, ensuring alignment, follow‑up of action points, and consistent internal communication.
  • Coordinate closely with FIFA Refereeing, FIFA Team Services and FIFA27 Team Services for all operational and administrative matters.
  • Assist in preparing and refining Referee Services operational concepts, policies, procedures and service plans.
  • Drive operational readiness for all referee‑related events, including workshops, seminars, test events, inspection visit or any other preparatory activities.
  • Act as the dedicated Refereeing representative for stadium and training site operational planning, ensuring full integration of referee‑specific requirements.
  • Lead the planning and delivery of VAR referee operations at the International Broadcast Center, in coordination with Technology, Broadcast Operations and VAR leadership.
  • Organize the FIFA Referee Cup and Pre‑competition Seminar prior to the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™.
  • Work closely with Workforce, Volunteers and HR on planning, recruiting, onboarding and training temporary staff and volunteers dedicated to Referee Services.
  • Identify, secure and coordinate local football teams to participate in daily practical training sessions with referees.
  • Prepare and deliver training materials, operational manuals and readiness exercises for Referee Services staff and volunteers.
  • Monitor the Referee Services budget in close coordination with Team Services, ensuring efficient and responsible use of resources.
  • Lead the overall project planning for Referee Services, managing timelines, milestones and deliverables across all team members.
  • Based at the Referee Base Camp, the Referee Operations Manager will transition to a Referee Liaison Officer (RLO) role and will be responsible for:
  • Reporting to and assisting FIFA Refereeing, as required, with all local arrangements (matches, training sessions, meetings, spectating referees, etc).
  • Cooperating with all FAs and service providers to support referees and FIFA Refereeing daily.
  • Coordinating the local players requested for the practical training sessions with the referees.
  • Exchanging information, in particular any last‑minute changes to the daily program, with training site authorities and all FAs involved in the referees’ daily operations.
  • Organizing social activities for the FIFA Refereeing delegation team during the competition, as required.
  • Supervising and coordinating the Referee Services support staff, including the Venue Referee Liaison Officers and volunteers at each stadium.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Excellent communicator with strong planning, organizational and administrative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to consistently deliver at a high standard.
  • Able to work closely and collaboratively with others, while being self‑motivated and able to work independently.
  • Able to manage a group of people working on the same projects and, as required, coordinate people in other functional areas to contribute to projects.
  • Capable of making decisions using problem‑solving skills and exercising sound judgment to achieve results.
  • Be very dynamic, stress‑resistant, motivated, excellent interpersonal and problem‑solving skills.
  • Comfortable working in an international, demanding and changing environment.
  • Able to adapt to and work well with people of other cultures and backgrounds.
  • Able to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain experienced and less experienced employees.
  • High energy levels, exceptional planning and organizational skills, strong negotiation and facilitation skills, excellent communication and presentation skills and positive relationship management abilities.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Portuguese and English are mandatory, and Spanish is a great plus.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Sr. Director of IT for Auxiliary Enterprises, the IT Support Specialist is responsible for providing general IT support across all Auxiliary Enterprises. IT‑related tasks may include setting up, managing, and troubleshooting technology systems used by each business unit associated with the Office of Auxiliary Enterprises. Duties may include providing end‑user support with laptop and desktop computers; providing support for card readers, printers or other IT and computer peripherals; assistance with Howard University physical and Wi‑Fi network; diagnosing and resolving hardware problems including specialized hardware such as point‑of‑sale terminals, building controllers, laundry machine interface devices, OR parking ticket issuing hand‑held terminals; configuring and updating system and application software; and tracking down data and communication issues.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides technical support for various hardware used across Auxiliary Enterprises including point‑of‑sale terminals, printers, laptops, desktop computers, cameras, card readers, scanners, contactless readers, monitors, kitchen‑display systems, time clocks, building/laundry controllers, building/laundry readers, point‑of‑sale terminals, peripherals, and other equipment used by contractors and employees in Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Provide Tier‑1 support for Dining Service point‑of‑sale terminals and peripherals.
  • Level Review diagnostics and assess the functionality and efficiency of systems.
  • Work with system providers in the support of various applications.
  • Work with Howard University ETS to Implement, enforce and support security measures.
  • Monitor security certificates and company compliance with requirements.
  • Monitor systems to ensure they are operating as expected.
  • Provide technical support to Auxiliary Enterprises contract staff and troubleshoot computer systems and peripheral equipment used by Auxiliary Enterprises contractors.
  • Install and update company software and hardware as needed.

  • Assist with installation, upgrades, and the disposal of IT‑related products.
  • Coordinate with ETS and off‑prem/cloud‑based vendors to ensure that Auxiliary Enterprises systems and data are backed up and back‑ups are verified and able to be restored when necessary.
  • Assemble, install, and configure systems and components per vendor specifications but within the policies, procedures, and best practices of Howard University, HU Enterprise Technology Services, and Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Stay updated regarding the knowledge and skills needed to keep up with rapid advancements in computer technology.
  • Maintains logs of activities and completed work and provides reports to the Sr. Director. Specifically, Laundry System Status and the Auxiliary Enterprises IT Asset List. Additional logs may be assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, networking, and related technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft Windows Operating system.
  • Ability to develop plans for resolving and implementing technical and operational problems.
  • Ability to work independently, to plan and prioritize activities that may span several locations on campus.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical problems due to complex system interfaces.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to operate in an office environment and in the field (various locations across all campuses of Howard University).
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the community.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or closely related field and one year relevant experience;

or equivalent combination of a total of five (5) years combined relevant education and experience.

Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer – L3 Support to work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux‑based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.

You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep‑diving difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountableYou value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux – kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equality and Diversity

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Partner Rights Delivery Manager
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Partnerships & Media

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team in Zurich and Brazil and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Head of Commercial Partnerships, the Partner Rights Delivery Manager supports the operational implementation and fulfillment of FIFA Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations. This role includes coordination of official sites requirements, stadiums preparations, and the delivery of Commercial Partners activities and related deliverables. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the planning and execution of the operational implementation and delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Commercial Partners agreements.
  • Implement and coordinate all commercial operations in line with the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition‑related events and sites.
  • Support the implementation of all commercial/sponsorship activations and commercial rights programmes of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Collaborate with the Stadium Venue Managers, Stadium Authorities, and relevant Functional Areas to ensure delivery of the contractual rights and obligations of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Assist in coordinating and delivering stadium inspections, open days, and Commercial Partner operational visits, ensuring alignment with commercial and F&B concessions requirements.
  • Manage and monitor the implementation of FIFA’s clean site obligation and Commercial Partners’ exclusivity in the official sites.
  • Ensure the Commercial Partners’ recognition programme is correctly implemented in designated stadium areas in accordance with established guidelines, including within the F&B concessions programme.
  • Assist in the implementation of specific commercial/marketing projects at the stadiums, such as Stadium Fan Experience areas, Special Marketing Programmes, Youth Programme, Value‑in‑Kind (VIK) operations, LED pitch side board operations, and other Commercial Partner activities, in coordination with the FIFA/FIFA27 project leads and the entire Partnership Rights Delivery team.
  • Act as an operational point of contact for Commercial Partners in the host country for commercial delivery matters, supporting issue resolution and expectation management throughout the event delivery process.
  • Work with PRD suppliers and assist them in the delivery of their obligations.
  • Support the planning and delivery of all Partnership Rights Delivery related spaces, facilities and flows in the stadiums (and other official sites) as per defined stadium requirements under the guidance of the FIFA PRD project lead.
  • Provide operational support to the Partnership Rights Delivery Venue Team (Marketing Venue Managers) during the tournament period.
  • Take primary responsibility for the administrative preparation and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive documentation, operational guidelines, briefing materials, tracking tools, and structured reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency across all Partnership Rights Delivery activities.
  • Prepare comprehensive reports, guidelines, and presentations on rights delivery progress, highlighting key achievements, risks, and recommendations.
  • Contribute to the preparation of tournament debrief documentation.
  • Assume administrative responsibility for the Partnership Rights Delivery team and provide support as required.

Your Profile

Education

  • University degree, ideally in Sports Management, Sports Administration, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field, with exposure to commercial/marketing operations or sponsorship activations.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in a comparable role within an international, fast‑paced, and project‑driven environment, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial operations and/or sponsorship activations in major event settings and/or the sports industry.
  • Experience working in international sports events or large‑scale event environments is considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.Experience in the planning and delivery of fan experience areas and activations is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Very strong administrative skills, with proven ability to produce high‑quality documentation, guidelines, reports, and structured tracking tools.
  • Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail and a structured working approach.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate and deliver projects within an event environment, manage priorities effectively, and work independently within defined responsibilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Service‑oriented mindset with a proactive and solution‑driven approach to commercial rights delivery.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and perform effectively under tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, persistence, and resilience in dynamic environments.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre‑tournament and operational tournament time).

title: Workday System Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area-related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid.
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management.
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions.
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions.
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption.
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releases and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday.
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements.
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements.
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies.
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases.
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality.
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root‑cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge‑base articles.
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes.
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross‑functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment.
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed.
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen.
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution.
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices.

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross-functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services.
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation.
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements.
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions.
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution.
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines.
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail.
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing.
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Strong problem‑solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience.
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training.
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $110,000 - $125,000

title: Software Engineer - Python - Cloud - graduate level
description:
Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Position

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu on public clouds.

The quality and stability of Ubuntu is critically important, as it is available on every public cloud. You’ll work with teams across Canonical and major cloud partners to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu cloud images. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.

This role requires quality‑oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability across a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The role involves creating and managing Ubuntu images; therefore, experience in configuring apt, knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous.

Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions worldwide. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. Ubuntu is used for a wide spectrum of users, from mission‑critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with them in mind.

Role Outline

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end‑system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on‑premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Fundada em 1986 por Paulo Martins da Luz (in memoriam), após sua brilhante trajetória profissional de 40 anos na multinacional TEXACO BRASIL S/A, onde atuou como diretor de Recursos Humanos, com o intuito de trazer para o mercado uma referência de terceirização de serviços e de mão de obra temporária, nascendo assim a PMLUZ CONSULTORIA DE RECURSOS HUMANOS LTDA especializada no fornecimento de mão de obra temporária e efetiva, fornecimento de treinamentos de equipes, administração de folhas de pagamento e gestão de pessoas.

O propósito de Paulo Martins estava em melhorar os processos de RH que eram bastante arcaicos e defasados na década de 80, com excelência nos processos de recrutamento e seleção, avaliações psicológicas para atividades de riscos, gestão administrativas e de pessoas, otimizando e diminuindo as burocracias e os riscos para seus clientes.

Em 2005, Alexandre Cerqueira Luz, formado em Administração com Pós-Graduação em Marketing e MBA em Recursos Humanos, assumiu a presidência da Pmluz Consultoria, trazendo uma visão moderna e bastante original, oferecendo um serviço mais personalizado para atender as particularidades de seus clientes.

Com grande experiência no mercado no segmento de Petróleo, Gás e Energia, foi fundada a PMLUZ ENERGY SERVIÇOS DE LOGISTICA LTDA, empresa especializada na prestação de serviços e cumprimento das normas criadas pela ANP 44/2013, elaborando uma metodologia atualizada, para flexibilizar e adaptar tais procedimentos, respeitando sempre a legislação, nossos valores e filosofia.

Hoje somos o GRUPO PMLUZ com prestação de serviços para contratos efetivos e temporários, gestão de pessoal, terceirização de folha de ponto e muitos outros serviços, atendendo os nossos clientes mantidos por mais de três décadas, em suas sedes e filiais em todo o Brasil.

E os nossos sonhos não param por aí, estamos sempre em busca de melhorias para facilitar nossos processos junto aos nossos, clientes, parceiros e colaboradores.

title: Concurso Perito e Investigador salários de até R$6.280,31
description:
Edital foi autorizado para concurso público de Perito e Investigador da Policia Civil do Rio de janeiro 2019. As 685 vagas estão divididas e 118 delas para o cargo de Investigador e as restantes, 567 para Inspetor da Policia Civil.

De acordo com o Governador do Estado do Rio foram autorizadas, além dessas, mais 400 vagas para o cargo de Técnico de Necropsia (80), Auxiliar de Necropsia (60), Perito (60) e Delegado (100).

Sobretudo, ainda não foi escolhida a banca organizadora, mas sabe-se que está em fase de propostas. De acordo com a Acadepol (Academia de Policia), oito bancas estão em analise para se decidir qual delas tomará conta do certame. O Concurso de Perito e Investigador terá salários de até R$6.280,31, confira tudo sobre os cargos e a prova.

Cargos concurso Perito e Investigador

Foto divulgação: Policiais Civis em serviço.

É fundamental que o candidato fique por dentro de todas as funções para o cargo que irá concorrer à vaga. Bem, em primeiro lugar é preciso saber quais as atribuições do cargo. Então agora vamos entender as funções, atribuições e também definições dos cargos em questão.

Concurso Perito e Investigador confira os cargos:

O correto é dizer é Auxiliar Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil, neste caso, cargo cujo nível de escolaridade exigido é o ensino fundamental. Sendo assim, os candidatos podem esperar por grande concorrência para o concurso público, isso porque o salário é de quase R$4.000,00 aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Auxiliar de Necropsia é responsável pelo o serviço de limpeza de cadáveres, bem como a limpeza e manutenção do local onde vai trabalhar.

2-Técnico de Necropsia

O termo correto para esse cargo é Técnico Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil. Todavia, esse cargo exige um nível maior de escolaridade sendo assim o candidato terá que ter o ensino médio, ou seja, não precisa ter formação de técnico de necropsia para concorrer a vaga. Contudo, esse também será um cargo muito concorrido, bem como o de Auxiliar de Necropsia, pois o salário de mais de 5 mil reais aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Técnico de Necropsia tem as funções de fazer a autópsia dos corpos e dissecação de cadáveres, sob supervisão direta de Peritos Policiais. Uma dúvida recorrente dos candidatos do Técnico e Auxiliar de Necropsia são sobre o porte de arma e a exigência de carteira de habilitação, nos últimos concursos não se exigia a carteira de motorista, é preciso esperar o edital para concluir essa informação. No entanto, o porte de arma é inerente aos servidores da Policia Civil.

As atividades do Inspetor de Policia é estar supervisionando e atento, pois irá coordenar os superiores em assuntos técnicos especializados e fiscalizar a operação. Além disso, a função de segurança, investigações e operações policiais.

As carreiras de Inspetor Policial podem ser de âmbito operacional, sendo assim, trabalham com as inteligências policiais e também administrativas nas delegacias.

Salário para Inspetor é de R$6.711,29, ou seja, uma remuneração bastante imponente. Para o cargo é exigido nível superior, e geralmente são chamados muitos candidatos.

O Investigador de Policia tem a remuneração inicial de R$ 6.108,85 aproximadamente. De acordo com notícias o cargo de Investigador passou por uma modificação e sofreia alterações no nível de escolaridade, mas a liminar foi derrubada e ficou sendo exigido nível médio, para a alegria de todos que já estavam estudando para o concurso.

Atribuições

Exercer com supervisão e autonomia coordenação e orientação do superior suas atividades de natureza relacionadas ao transporte de autoridades garantindo total segurança, entre outras funções básicas que estão de acordo com o edital do concurso.

5-Delegado de Polícia

O Delegado de Policia que fizer o Concurso Perito e Investigador, aprovado em todas as fases do iniciará seu trabalho cumprindo os seguintes deveres:

  • Concorrer para a manutenção da ordem pública;
  • Assegurar a observância da lei;
  • Defender as instituições públicas;
  • Promover a prevenção, a apuração e a repressão das infrações penais;
  • Assegurar o exercício pleno da cidadania e das liberdades individuais;
  • Exercer atividades de nível superior, compreendendo supervisão, planejamento, coordenação e controle, no mais alto nível de hierarquia da Administração Policial do Estado, entre outras funções conforme o edital.

Etapas do concurso

A prova tem quatro etapas, visto que a primeira a provaobjetiva, com as matérias de língua portuguesa, informática, constitucional,administrativo, penal e processo penal. Além de tudo, lei de drogas e estatutodo direito civil, tudo incluído no edital.

O concurso para Perito e Investigador é bastante almejado. Passando pela prova objetiva terá as outras três avaliações: psicotécnico, exame médico e prova de capacidade física. Logo após isso, entrará para a Acadepol para passar pela investigação social.

Resumo concurso Perito e Investigador Polícia Civil do Rio

O Concurso Perito e Investigador, para o cargo deAuxiliar de Necropsia daPolícia Civil/RJ ,. terá a exigência de nível fundamental e receberá uma remuneração de R$4.743,12. Já paraTécnico de Necropsia , é exigido nível médio para o salário de R$5.277,59.

OInspetor dePolícia Civil é necessário nível superior e os aprovados receberão o salário deR$6.280,31. O cargo de Investigador também exige a mesma escolaridade. Para oposto, o salário é de R$5.740,38.

A exigência para o cargo de Delegado, no Concurso Perito e Investigador é de nível superior em Direito, devendo com o diploma devidamente registrado para exercer a função com remuneração é de R$18.747,95.

Detalhes do concurso

  • Concurso : Perito e Investigador Estado do Rio de Janeiro (PC-RJ)
  • Escolaridade : fundamental, médio e superior

description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

To provide comprehensive administrative support to ensure the efficient operation of the office and assists with the coordination of program activities. The incumbent facilitates communication between teams ensuring that projects run smoothly and meet organizational goals. The incumbent serves as a liaison between administrative program staff and the rest of the university stakeholders in meeting the operational and logistical needs of the department. This position will report to the Associate Dean of Research Graduate Programs.

Supervisory Authority

Has responsibility or authority which is limited to the direction of student workers.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts may include senior administrators, faculty, students, and staff. External contacts may include vendors, consultants, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provide comprehensive administrative and program support to ensure efficient office operations, including managing, and making travel arrangements for senior staff.
  • Maintain filing systems, operate and maintain office equipment, and coordinate repairs and maintenance.
  • Answer and direct phone calls, respond to digital correspondence, and greet visitors.
  • Coordinate logistics for meetings and events, including room setup, catering, and reservations.
  • Arrange meetings, schedule conferences, as directed by supervisor; notifies attendees or participants in logistics.
  • Serve as a liaison to faculty by overseeing and managing all travel authorization requests, ensuring completeness, accuracy of required documentation, and compliance with institutional policies. Manage the College of Arts and Sciences travel inbox, responding to inquiries related to travel and reimbursements while ensuring the timely processing of travel and expense reimbursements. Develop, maintain, and communicate clear policies and procedures related to university travel and expense reimbursement.
  • Maintain filing systems, operate and maintain office equipment, and coordinate repairs and maintenance.
  • Answer and direct phone calls, respond to digital correspondence, and greet visitors.
  • The Administrative Program Coordinator will work with Associate Dean of Research Graduate Programs - responsible for the oversight and day-to-day management of faculty start-up funds, ensuring compliance with institutional, sponsor, and financial policies. This role supports faculty by monitoring expenditures, reconciling accounts, and providing guidance on allowable costs, while coordinating with the Provost Office, and Sponsored Programs to ensure timely and accurate processing of transactions.
  • Assists with the coordination of the program’s seminars, workshops, travel arrangements, special projects, and/or events; may coordinate programs/project development planning.
  • Ensure timely dissemination of information to students and faculty through the design and maintenance of bulletin boards and electronic documents.
  • Assist in program budget management, documentation, and proofreading.
  • Act as a liaison between departments, vendors, and other internal and external stakeholders. Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Proficient knowledge of word processing, spreadsheets, database programs, and presentation software to perform a variety of project-related assignments. Knowledge of general office procedures and practices.
  • Ability to effectively communicate in a clear and concise manner both orally and in writing.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the community.
  • Ability to develop action plans in resolving and implementing organizational and operational problem goals.
  • Ability to plan and prioritize multiple activities in an office setting.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree required and relevant 1-3 years of experience in program administration or assistance. 6 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.

Other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not construed as a contract for employment.

title: ELETROMEC NICO (BANCO DE TALENTOS)
description:
O Oficial de Manutenção Especializada II é responsável por realizar a manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em sistemas e equipamentos eletromecânicos complexos, assegurando a operação eficiente e segura das instalações. Este profissional atua na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos, realizando ajustes e reparos especializados para garantir a continuidade das operações.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Executar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas eletromecânicos, como motores, bombas, geradores, e sistemas automatizados, conforme os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Diagnosticar e resolver falhas em equipamentos eletromecânicos, substituindo componentes danificados e realizando ajustes necessários para garantir o funcionamento adequado.
  • Ler e interpretar esquemas elétricos e mecânicos, manuais técnicos e diagramas para realizar as manutenções e reparos de acordo com as especificações.
  • Realizar testes e medições em sistemas e equipamentos para verificar a eficiência e segurança operacional, utilizando ferramentas e instrumentos apropriados.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de manutenção preditiva, monitorando o desempenho dos equipamentos e identificando possíveis falhas antes que se tornem problemas críticos.
  • Manter registros detalhados das atividades de manutenção realizadas, incluindo os materiais utilizados, problemas identificados e soluções aplicadas.
  • Seguir as normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais estabelecidos, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) adequados e assegurando um ambiente de trabalho seguro.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de manutenção e engenheiros para garantir a integração e eficiência dos sistemas eletromecânicos com outros componentes das instalações.
  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações técnicas para se manter atualizado com as novas tecnologias e práticas de manutenção.

Requisitos

  • Ensino técnico completo em Eletromecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prévia em manutenção eletromecânica ou áreas similares, com conhecimento avançado em sistemas e equipamentos eletromecânicos.
  • Habilidade na leitura e interpretação de esquemas elétricos e mecânicos, manuais técnicos e diagramas.
  • Conhecimento das normas técnicas e de segurança aplicáveis à manutenção de sistemas eletromecânicos.
  • Certificações e cursos de especialização em manutenção eletromecânica (desejável).
