FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament‑wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk‑informed decision‑making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament‑wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non‑competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions

Your profile

Education

  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi‑agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Sobre a Vaga: Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Limpeza dinâmico e proativo para liderar nossas equipes operacionais. Nesta função, você será o elo fundamental entre a estratégia da empresa e a execução impecável no cliente. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários para otimizar a performance da equipe.

Sobre a Empresa: Fundada em 2007, a GSS Segurança e Serviços consolidou-se como uma das referências no setor de segurança patrimonial e facilities no Brasil. Com sede em São Paulo e filial no Rio de Janeiro, nossa história é pautada pela entrega de soluções personalizadas e eficazes que trazem tranquilidade e proteção ao patrimônio de nossos clientes.

Atuamos com uma metodologia que une análise profunda de necessidades à tecnologia de ponta, oferecendo desde vigilância especializada até serviços de limpeza, portaria e recepção. Nossa trajetória é marcada pelo compromisso com a idoneidade e pelo reconhecimento do mercado como uma empresa ética e moderna.

Cultura e Equipe: Na GSS, acreditamos que nossos profissionais são os alicerces do nosso sucesso. Nossa cultura é fundamentada em quatro pilares essenciais: Respeito, Ética, Qualidade e Proatividade .

Somos defensores da humanização e da inclusão no setor de segurança e serviços. Orgulhamo-nos de adotar iniciativas como a cartilha "Segurança Sem Preconceito", reafirmando nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e livre de discriminação.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você encontrará um ambiente colaborativo, focado em resultados e que valoriza a capacitação constante. Buscamos pessoas que tenham o desejo de crescer junto conosco e que compartilham da nossa paixão por servir com excelência e integridade.

O texto foi elaborado para atrair um perfil que equilibre a capacidade técnica (manuseio de produtos e equipamentos) com a gestão humanizada , alinhada à cultura de ética e respeito da empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Nesta função, o Supervisor será o responsável por garantir que a excelência operacional da GSS seja percebida diariamente pelo cliente. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  • Gestão de Equipes: Coordenar, escalas de trabalho, controlar a frequência (faltas e substituições) e aplicar feedbacks constantes para manter o engajamento do time de limpeza.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Realizar rondas e inspeções técnicas frequentes nos postos de serviço para garantir que os padrões de higienização e conservação estejam sendo rigorosamente seguidos.
  • Gestão de Insumos: Monitorar o estoque de materiais de limpeza e EPIs, garantindo o uso consciente, a diluição correta de produtos químicos e a solicitação de reposição em tempo hábil.
  • Treinamento Operacional: Capacitar os colaboradores no manuseio de maquinários (enceradeiras, lavadoras de alta pressão, aspiradores industriais) e na aplicação de técnicas de limpeza técnica e hospitalar (se aplicável).

  • Interface com o Cliente: Atender prontamente as solicitações dos contratantes, resolvendo intercorrências operacionais com agilidade e reportando o status dos serviços através de relatórios técnicos.
  • Documentação Operacional: Preencher cronogramas, checklists de limpeza e relatórios de supervisão de forma organizada e digital.

title: Analista de Marketing Direto
description:
1. COMO É SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE MARKETING DIRETO EM MSF-BRASIL?

Você irá desenvolver, implementar e analisar ações de marketing direto, com ênfase em canais offline como malas diretas e cartas de relacionamento, visando fortalecer o vínculo com a base de pessoas doadoras, ampliar a captação de recursos e potencializar o engajamento e a retenção.

Além disso, irá atuar com inovação nas abordagens, otimizando as ações de relacionamento e maximização dos resultados, acompanhando o desempenho das campanhas, identificando oportunidades de melhorias e novos formatos. Além disso, atuar para que todas as ações e materiais de marketing direto reflitam práticas de diversidade, equidade e inclusão, utilizando linguagem acolhedora, acessível e representativa, considerando diferentes perfis da base de pessoas doadoras.

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Contribuir para a sustentabilidade e o crescimento da rentabilidade do canal offline, buscando a máxima de resultados e eficiência em custos de produção e logística postal;
  • Evoluir o modelo de marketing direto offline, incorporando análises mais profundas de dados e maior integração com estratégias de canais digitais;
  • Contribuir para uma cultura de análise e otimização contínua, orientando as ações baseadas em dados e subsidiando decisões.

3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Atividades de Marketing e Relacionamento

  • Planejar, implementar e otimizar campanhas de marketing direto offline (malas, cartas e materiais impressos), contribuindo com a Coordenação desde a construção até a mensuração dos resultados;
  • Executar segmentações e propor novos critérios e testes A/B, documentando aprendizados, hipóteses, resultados e fluxos;
  • Supervisionar o fluxo de produção com pessoas fornecedoras internas e externas de mala direta e materiais institucionais, assegurando prazos, qualidade e respeitando orçamento e custos finais de acordo com a verba disponível;
  • Acompanhar e realizar análise de resultados de campanhas, elaborando relatórios e propondo melhorias com base em métricas, como taxa de resposta, custo por aquisição, valor médio de doação e taxa de retenção;
  • Contribuir para que as peças, textos e segmentações adotem linguagem inclusiva, evitando vieses ou estereótipos e assegurando que diferentes perfis de pessoas doadoras se sintam respeitados e representados;
  • Acompanhar tendências e benchmarks de mercado em marketing direto e relacionamento com pessoas doadoras, aplicando boas práticas e sugerindo melhorias;
  • Considerar acessibilidade e inclusão nas propostas e revisões de materiais impressos e digitais, identificando ajustes que tornem a comunicação mais clara e inclusiva;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o planejamento anual de marketing direto, identificando oportunidades de inovação, otimização de processos e aumento de eficiência;
  • Contribuir para a integração das ações de marketing direto com campanhas digitais, fortalecendo a jornada multicanal da pessoa doadora;
  • Adotar metodologias ágeis, trabalhando em ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as demais células do Hub, assegurando coesão das estratégias de relacionamento e desenvolvimento, de acordo com os objetivos estratégicos de cada área;

Compromissos Institucionais – MSF-Brasil

  • Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho ético, equitativo e inclusivo, pautado pela escuta ativa, pelo respeito e pela colaboração;
  • Conhecer e aplicar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização no exercício de suas atividades, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios institucionais;
  • Colaborar com outras áreas e equipes de forma proativa, contribuindo para o fortalecimento do trabalho transversal e para a melhoria contínua de processos;
  • Contribuir, dentro de suas atribuições, para a implementação dos objetivos definidos nos planejamentos estratégico e operacional, com responsabilidade sobre suas entregas e atenção à qualidade do trabalho;
  • Adotar práticas que valorizem a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão, respeitando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e contribuindo para um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas.

Requisitos:

4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Graduação completa em Marketing e áreas afins
  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes/pessoas doadoras ou comunicação (campanhas offline)
  • Proficiência intermediária em Inglês
  • Conhecimentos de Pacote office e CRM
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de BI, relatórios de performance e análise de resultados
  • Conhecimentos de diversidade, equidade e inclusão em campanhas

5. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?

Você precisará demonstrar pensamento analítico para interpretar dados e apoiar a tomada de decisões nas ações de marketing direto. Será essencial manter planejamento e organização para gerenciar atividades, prazos e entregas com qualidade. A iniciativa e a inovação serão importantes para propor melhorias e ajustes nos processos, assim como a capacidade de negociação para atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas internas e fornecedores, buscando soluções alinhadas aos objetivos de MSF.

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA:

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, iremos priorizar a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem como parte de grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans e PcD.

Venha fazer parte da equipe de Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil!

RETORNO:

Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno sobre sua participação.

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager will work closely with the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure the planning, implementation, and delivery of the ticketing operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. This role will be responsible for managing the ticketing operations at the stadiums and all ticketing facilities in the host country. Further, this role will oversee the creation and maintenance of seating maps in the ticketing system, as well as the assignment of ticket holders to seats in accordance with FIFA policies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the Ticketing Operations team in Brazil in the overall tournament planning, ensuring the team has the guidance, resources, and support required to deliver their roles successfully.
  • Foster strong collaboration within the local team and with the Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure consistent operational alignment.
  • Implement system configuration according to the specifications set by the Zurich team, maintaining accuracy and consistency across all platforms.
  • Oversee and manage the ticketing inventory, including the creation, maintenance, and continuous updating of seating plans for all host venues in the ticketing system.
  • Plan, prepare, and supervise the full on‑site ticketing operation, including the setup and management of all required infrastructure and equipment.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain ticketing policies and procedures to ensure operational excellence and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination with other functional areas as well as the host stadium to support a seamless event delivery.
  • Oversee all electronic access control operations in the host venues, ensuring proper configuration, integration, and match‑day readiness.
  • Plan, schedule, and conduct site visits as required to assess operational needs, validate infrastructure, and coordinate with venue stakeholders.
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events as required.

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience
  • 8+ years of experience in ticketing operations for major sports events, venues, or entertainment properties.
  • Experience delivering ticketing operations for multi‑venue events or international tournaments is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms and access control technologies.
  • Strong operational planning and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced event environment with multiple deadlines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.
Skills & Competencies
  • Leadership and team management
  • Operational planning and execution
  • Stakeholder management
  • Problem solving and decision making
  • Communication and coordination
  • Attention to detail
  • Risk management mindset
Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Visa & Immigration Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to both the Head of Government and Host City Management and Manager of Government and Host City Management, the Visa & Immigration Manager will serve as the primary liaison between the FIFA 2027 team, an external immigration service provider, and government authorities involved in visa and immigration processes. The position will be based in the Headquarters at Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

The role will be responsible for supporting the coordination and operational delivery of streamlined and compliant visa procedures for FIFA workforce, delegates, PMAs, VIPs, and guests for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This position will work closely with internal stakeholders and government entities to ensure clear communication, aligned processes, and efficient case handling.

Key responsibilities

  • Coordinating the day‑to‑day execution of visa and immigration processes for all FIFA constituent groups, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and adherence to timelines.
  • Acting as the central point of contact for the external immigration provider, monitoring service quality, documentation standards, and operational performance.
  • Providing guidance on immigration requirements, documentation needs, and expected processing timelines to internal teams and relevant clients, such as workforce, officials, VIPs, Participating Member Association, and other stakeholders.
  • Assisting in compliance activities, including monitoring regulatory changes, ensuring procedural adherence, and escalating risks or complex cases when needed.
  • Supporting interactions with government bodies and consulates by preparing documentation, consolidating information, and facilitating responses to official inquiries.
  • Maintaining updated records, and case‑tracking tools to ensure visibility of progress, bottlenecks, and pending tasks.
  • Preparing operational and financial reports related to immigration services, including cost summaries and monthly reconciliations.
  • Developing and maintaining a network of contacts within government entities, consulates, and immigration‑related institutions.
  • Participating in meetings, workshops, and events when required.
  • Providing support during peak operational periods, including occasional evening or weekend work.
  • Offering guidance and knowledge transfer to FIFA departments and related entities on immigration procedures.
  • Providing visa support for FIFA staff business travel when necessary.

Your profile

  • Completion of a related University degree or diploma.
  • 3–5 years of experience in visa and immigration operations or a similar role.
  • Experience working with external vendors or service providers.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office proficiency.
  • Additional certification in business administration is an asset.
  • Experience in international or cross‑cultural work environments preferred.
  • Problem solving and conflict resolution skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and sound judgment, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively and diplomatically with all counterparts, achieving high quality results in difficult and challenging circumstances.
  • Ability to embrace change and be highly adaptable to new challenges and opportunities.
  • Experience working in multicultural, multi‑disciplinary teams, ideally with immigration professionals.
  • Project and event management experience is considered an advantage.
  • Practical knowledge of global mobility or international administrative processes is beneficial.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Graphic designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments. You will lead the creative development and localisation of Brand Graphic assets ensuring consistent, world-class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football. Purpose of the Role: This role combines world class graphic design excellence, strong project management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in the realm of sports and entertainment. This role reports to the Global head of Brand, marketing & promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines. Solid experience in Graphic Design in brand development context is mandatory.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Own, drive and oversee creative process and localisation across channels ensuring high-quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Inline with Brand Guidelines and central Brand direction, direct and produce creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develop key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital-first creative assets.

Project Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead junior designer and external creative partners to deliver cohesive, high-impact work across formats and platforms.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external partners to align creative outputs with business and brand objectives.
  • Brief, manage, and evaluate external agencies, production partners, ensuring creative alignment and production quality.

Brand Guardianship & Design Systems

  • Ensure strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards, while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven HANDS -ON expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Important : Experience working with large-scale brand projects, live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in senior graphic or art direction roles within agency, sports events or Entertainment.

Competencies and Personality

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic Design solid experience in the context of Brand creation and brand assets and collateral
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High-level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands-on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Rigor

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.

description:
Coordinator, Volunteer Communications and Engagement

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager, the Volunteer Communications and Engagement Coordinator will play a key role in shaping the volunteer experience for thousands of volunteers across the eight host cities. You will help integrate, craft, and deliver inspiring, informative, and consistent messaging that keeps our volunteers engaged and connected throughout their journey — before, during, and after the tournament.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the daily operations of the Volunteer Communications and Engagement team by assisting the Communications & Engagement Manager with internal and external deliverables. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, copywriting emails, dashboards, articles, and newsletters in both English and Portuguese; updating communications on the volunteer platform; coordinating content for social media and internal channels; and providing additional support as needed.
  • Update and maintain the Volunteer Platform (Volunteer Management System) according to the communication needs of each Volunteer journey milestone, ensuring all content and templates are accurate and ready for use.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of communication strategies that foster volunteer engagement across all phases of the programme. From application, recruitment, role offer, training until the end of the tournament and their participation.
  • Support the design and delivery of a comprehensive volunteer engagement strategy, including key messaging and content pillars aligned with the tournament’s values.
  • Support the development and delivery of the Recognition Programme, including overseeing orders and brand approvals for volunteer gifts.
  • Draft and edit compelling content, including volunteer guides, FAQs, and platform updates, tailored for internal platforms, social media, and volunteer contact centres.
  • Coordinate content production, including graphic design requests and translation workflows (English, Portuguese).
  • Create editorial content for key channels such as the FIFA Volunteer Instagram, FIFA Home, and the FWWC2027 Volunteer Newsletter.
  • Assist in planning and executing volunteer events and promotional activities that build community and enhance the volunteer experience.
  • Provide administrative and project support across the Volunteer Communications team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders as needed.
  • Support planning and development of a content plan for the different milestones.
  • Coordinate and support the collection, curation, and writing of volunteer profiles, stories, captions, and visual narratives for the “Volunteer Profile Bank”, capturing content from volunteers in all eight host cities.
  • Help organize and coordinate volunteer participation in media activities, interviews, and events.
  • Organize, curate, and maintain an updated library of volunteer-related assets (brand identity files, photos, videos, templates, guidelines, etc.).
  • Ensure all assets are easy to locate, properly labelled, and accessible to the team.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Project Management, or related field, or similar level of higher education
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in a communications function
  • Experience in operating a Volunteer Management Platform or CRM
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, both oral and written
  • Ability to see the big picture and adapt accordingly
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail in all tasks and deliverables
  • Previous professional or volunteer experience in major sports events is highly desirable
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project), planning software, and online collaboration tools
  • Knowledge of HTML coding is a plus
  • Design skills and proficiency with design suites (e.g., Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, Figma), as well as content creation apps such as CapCut and SCRL, are considered an asset
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Start date: 05 May (tentative or to be agreed)

The Department of English in the College of Arts and Sciences at Howard University invites applications for a tenure-track position at the advanced assistant or early associate professor level with research interests in the area of American literature with expertise in one of the related fields of Creative Writing. We welcome applicants who can bridge American literary studies with one or more of the following areas of study: African American Literature, Indigenous Literature, African Diaspora Literatures of the Americas, Afro-futurism and science/speculative fiction, environmental literature, Black theatre and popular cultures. Successful candidates are expected to develop extramurally funded research programs in their areas of expertise, actively participate in the Department's teaching and curriculum development at the undergraduate and graduate levels, and mentor undergraduate and graduate students. Evidence of interest and success in mentoring underrepresented students is highly desired.

Howard University, a culturally diverse, comprehensive, research intensive and historically Black private university, provides an educational experience of exceptional quality at the undergraduate, graduate, and professional levels to students of high academic standing and potential, with particular emphasis upon educational opportunities for Black students. Howard University was currently classified as an R1 research university. It is a residential campus of approximately 14,000 students located in the heart of the nation’s capital, Washington, DC.

The Department of English currently consists of 22 tenured/tenure-track faculty members, conducting research with specializations in African, African American, American, British and Caribbean and comparative literatures and critical theory. It offers BA and PhD degrees in these areas and is developing an M.F.A. in Creative Writing.

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru.

Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.

Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self‑motivated, creative team member integral to the long‑term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.

Responsibilities

International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy & Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.
  • Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.
  • Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.
  • Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners).
  • Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.

Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries

  • In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy & Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.
  • Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.
  • As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.
  • Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.

Blue Climate Program

  • Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.
  • Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

Working Conditions

  • Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.
  • Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
  • Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.
  • Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.
  • Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.
  • Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.
  • Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.
  • Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.
  • Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions
  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.
  • Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.

title: Senior Workday Security Admin
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

This role plays a key part in optimizing Workday’s capabilities to support student, faculty, and administrative needs, while partnering with stakeholders across functional teams to drive innovation, improve business processes, and safeguard critical data in a complex, dynamic higher education environment. Ensures robust data security and best practices are in place within Workday and across the university. With a focus on user experience and Workday Illuminate AI (and Agentic AI), leads AI innovation through Workday Extend applications and IT developed configuration by working in collaboration with Business Units from concept to final execution; including the development, configuration, and maintenance of Workday applications in order to support business processes. Requires creativity and expertise with the user experience to transform business requirements into designing, building, and delivering effective solutions.

Supervisory Authority

The Senior Workday Security Administrator reports to the Workday Product Owner is vital to align development goals with organizational strategy and operational efficiency. This role may provide guidance to team members and colleagues working within the Enterprise Technology Services department. This position involves managerial and supervisory responsibilities in areas of security, access, and Workday development and works in collaboration with cross-functional teams, overseeing project-specific tasks related to Workday implementations, and ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards is expected. The Senior Workday Security Administrator is responsible for overseeing daily tasks, providing mentorship, and ensuring alignment with Howard University's policies and objectives along with evaluating performance, ensuring the effective execution of security protocols and fostering a collaborative work environment that supports operational excellence.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role ensures that Workday security and Workday applications that support the user experience are designed to meet business needs and maintain compliance with regulatory and auditing requirements. Scalable solutions are designed to align with organizational goals and improve operational efficiency.

Principal Accountabilities

Security Configuration and Access

  • Own and maintain a secure and scalable Workday security framework to include integrations, role-based security, security groups, domain security policies, and business process security policies, user provisioning (authentication policy), and proxy policy to control user access and permissions.
  • Conduct regular security reviews, access audits, and recommend improvements based on findings.
  • Analyze and design Workday security to ensure users have the appropriate and necessary permissions to perform their job role and functions.

Auditing and Compliance

  • Comply with compliance and audit requirements by conducting regular security assessments and supporting audit readiness to ensure regulatory and privacy requirements are met.
  • Provide guidance on segregation of duties (SoD) and least-privilege access principles.
  • Manage the monitoring controls set up to protect sensitive institutional and personal data in compliance with FERPA, HIPAA, and other applicable regulations.
  • Maintain documentation related to system configurations and processes, documenting proper internal security controls.

Development, Security, and Testing

  • Collaborate stakeholders across HR, Finance, Student, and IT teams to understand business needs, to identify continuous improvement opportunities for streamlining processes and operations through Workday Illuminate AI and Agentic AI, Workday Extend and other IT developed configuration, and to translate them into scalable, secure solutions for a quality user experience.
  • Oversee and lead in the full development lifecycle of Workday Extend applications and other IT developed configuration to support University priorities – from requirement gathering to architecture, design, development, testing, and deployment, and post‑implementation support.
  • Ensure adherence to Workday best practices and maintain high performance and scalability of Extend apps and other IT developed configuration.
  • Support functionality design, testing, and migration along with and as it relates to Workday development and security and create and update reports as operationally needed.

Adoption and Support

  • Serve as the primary liaison with Workday Security community forums to stay abreast of Workday releases and functionality, product updates, best practices, changing development capabilities, evolving security trends, and emerging issues relevant to higher education.
  • Adhere to and align with best practices for Workday governance, release management, and change control in pursuit of institutional goals.
  • Research and recommend enhancements to maximize the capabilities of the system.
  • Develop and maintain a Workday roadmap for security and IT developed solutions that is aligned with business objectives and with respect to releases, reviewing release notes, and assessing and understanding the impacts on security in the tenants.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, responsibility, collaboration, communication, and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in Change Control process with functional areas to review, approve and execute change requests related to Workday applications, IT developed configurations, and Workday Security.

Minimum Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent experience in fields related to business administration, information technology, computer science, or software development; including 5 or more years of experience in Higher Education with Workday security and development that includes Workday Extend; minimum of 3 years technical experience with Workday related to functionality of Finance, Human Capital Management, Adaptive, and Student modules.
  • Familiarity with higher education processes and best practices.
  • Experience in designing, configuring, testing, and supporting functional areas, including process documentation.
  • Hands‑on experience with Workday Extend, all aspects of Workday Security, Business Processes, Workday Reporting and other core Workday functionality in a higher education environment.
  • Workday certifications in Extend, Security, or Integration, Business Process and Report Writer preferred.
  • Familiarity with JSON, REST APIs, and strong understanding of object‑oriented programming XML, XSLT, JSON, and API technologies and Workday Report Writer.
  • Knowledge of ITIL, Agile, SDLC, DevOps, and CI/CD methodologies.
  • Experience supporting multiple priorities and projects concurrently. Must be able to thrive in a demanding, change‑oriented, fast‑paced environment.
  • Understanding project management and service life cycle concepts and practices.
  • Proven experience collaborating with cross‑functional Workday teams.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Background in SOX compliance, GDPR, or other data privacy regulations, preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $125,000 - $140,000

title: Asbestos Surveyor
description:
Shape Safer Environments Through Technical Excellence

Every building has a story hidden within its structure. As an Asbestos Surveyor, you’ll be the person who uncovers the detail, applies technical expertise and ensures that clients across the UK can make informed, safe and confident decisions. If you enjoy autonomy, thrive in varied environments and take pride in accuracy and clarity, this role offers genuine scope to grow, influence and create meaningful impact.

We have multiple roles available that will either cover locations across the Southeast and London or solely cover the Darlington area in the Northeast. In addition to the very competitive salary and overtime rates, we also offer a company car or a car allowance, giving you the flexibility and support you need for your role.

Purpose & Scope of the Role

This role exists to deliver high quality, UKAS compliant asbestos surveying services across a wide-ranging portfolio of commercial and industrial properties. You will carry out management, refurbishment and demolition surveys, collecting precise inspection data and producing clear, robust reports aligned with UKAS accreditation and HSE guidance. Working largely independently on client sites, you will conduct detailed inspections, bulk sampling and risk assessments, offering technically sound insights that support compliance, risk control and asset management. You will work closely with internal quality and project teams while interacting directly with clients, facilities personnel and other stakeholders.

Reporting to the Regional Operations Manager, you will operate across offices, public buildings, retail, healthcare, education, manufacturing and infrastructure environments. The role involves travelling to multiple sites, managing personal workloads and deadlines, and ensuring exceptional data integrity. All work is supported by digital surveying tools, structured reporting systems and a mature quality assurance framework.

Your Impact in This Position

In the early stages, you will establish yourself as a dependable technical specialist, delivering consistently high quality surveys and building trusted relationships with both clients and colleagues. As your experience deepens, you will gain exposure to larger, more complex survey projects and play a part in service improvements and broader consultancy activities. This includes involvement in major commercial and industrial projects, reinspection projects and asbestos management reviews.

Longer‑term, this position offers multiple progression pathways, including senior surveying responsibilities, technical auditing, project management or leadership roles within the consultancy. Ongoing professional development and access to diverse sites and contracts provide a strong foundation for sustained career growth.

Core Capabilities

  • Asbestos Surveying – Plan and deliver comprehensive management, refurbishment and demolition surveys across commercial and industrial environments, identifying and sampling asbestos‑containing materials with precision.
  • Asbestos Expertise – Serve as the trusted technical authority, understanding asbestos materials, behaviours and associated risks across demanding sectors such as aviation, pharmaceuticals and utilities.
  • Regulatory Compliance and Technical Knowledge – Apply asbestos legislation and industry standards with confidence, ensuring every survey is compliant, proportionate and grounded in evidence.
  • Data Capturing, Reporting & Quality Assurance – Record detailed observations, assessments and sample information using digital platforms, and produce well‑structured technical reports that reflect attention to detail and clarity.
  • Client Communication & Consultancy Skills – Communicate technical findings clearly and professionally, fostering trust and providing proportionate, actionable advice to clients, facilities teams and project managers.

Qualifications & Experience

You will hold BOHS P402 or an equivalent RSPH qualification, along with demonstrable experience of undertaking asbestos surveys within a UKAS accredited setting. You will already be authorised for management, refurbishment and demolition surveys and bring strong IT, literacy and numeracy skills. A full UK driving licence is essential.

Working Environment

We support flexible arrangements, including three or four day working weeks. Overtime opportunities may be available and are remunerated at enhanced rates. You will plan site visits in advance to support effective scheduling and maintain a healthy work‑life balance. Periodic office attendance is expected for collaboration, training, quality reviews and wider team engagement. The role involves regular travel to client sites and occasional support for out‑of‑hours projects.

Why join Tetra Tech?

Tetra Tech is a leading provider of consulting and engineering services working across the full project lifecycle worldwide. We have a wide range of expertise across our teams, providing a global support network with a personalised approach to client relationships to better understand where we can add value. We provide a collaborative environment that supports individual performance, innovation, and creativity.

We support public and private sector clients on local, national, and international projects to deliver sustainable and resilient solutions. Our operations in the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands include more than 6,000 employees who are Leading with Science® to solve our clients’ most complex problems.

In alignment with the Equality Act 2010, we will make reasonable adjustments to support candidates and employees requiring additional arrangements. This could include adaptations to work schedules, training approaches, or the physical workspace. Please inform us if you need any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your day‑to‑day role.

Recruitment Agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on this list and any submitted will be taken as a gift. Please refer to the careers page on our website if you require any further information.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

As part of Howard University’s newly‑launched Institute for Advanced Study (HIAS), The Emancipator is an award‑winning nonprofit digital magazine that reimagines the nation’s first abolitionist newspapers for a new day. Our mission, like those who came before us, is to leverage the power of journalism to turn public opinion against racist policies and ideas. We expose the history, harms, and pervasiveness of racial inequity and injustice in all aspects of life, and explore solutions for its abolition. From health disparities, the wealth gap, climate inequality and police violence to racism experienced by those throughout the world, The Emancipator confronts the biggest racial justice issues of our time.

Job Purpose

As a key member of The Emancipator’s editorial team, the Breaking News Correspondent is an integral part of the news organization’s daily news coverage ensuring we “stay in the conversation” with mission‑focused content that is sharp, timely, relevant, fast, deftly researched and vetted, and well reported and written. The Breaking News Correspondent nimbly reports, writes, and web produces timely news stories, essays, scripts, and social posts. This position offers early‑career journalists an opportunity to build their reporting muscles in a fast‑paced, mission‑driven newsroom with hands‑on mentorship and clear growth pathways. You’ll learn to strengthen reporting, writing, and publishing regularly in a collaborative newsroom where editors provide active feedback and development. This position is funded by a one‑year grant, with the possibility of renewal. The Breaking News Correspondent reports directly to the Managing Editor.

Supervisory Authority

While this role has no direct supervisory authority, the Breaking News Correspondent may be asked to help mentor student interns and/or student employees. This role may be asked to serve as lead on projects related to helping promote The Emancipator’s editorial mission and goals.

Nature And Scope

This position will interact with faculty, staff, students, and internal and external contacts.

Newsroom

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Collaborate with The Emancipator team on editorial matters
  • Ensure the confidentiality and preservation of sensitive information
  • Adhere to newsroom operational structure and editorial workflows
  • Attend newsroom meetings and events as well as those conducted by HIAS more broadly where required and as needed
  • Utilize editorial support services such as webpage hosting, photos, videos, Slack, and social media

Editorial

  • Serve as a collegial, professional, and efficient newsroom presence
  • Support the strategic editorial coverage plan and execution
  • Adhere to the publishing calendar and cadence
  • Pitch timely, relevant, mission‑aligned content
  • Report, write, and web produce stories, essays, scripts, social posts

Collaboration And Communication

  • Collaborate with team members and contribute to group projects
  • Support fellow reporters, producers, and freelancers by offering feedback and guidance
  • Help maintain a collegial and professional newsroom environment
  • Coordinate with other departments or external partners when necessary and directed
  • Communicate collegially, clearly and effectively, both in writing and verbally

Professional Development And Media Appearances

  • Collaborate with the Editor‑In‑Chief and Managing Editor on the pursuit of and attendance at professional development opportunities such as conferences, lectures, and speaking engagements
  • Collaborate with the Editor‑In‑Chief and Managing Editor and, where applicable, Howard University public relations office, on media appearances and statements

Core Competencies

Technical Proficiency:

  • Highly skilled in reporting and writing
  • Proficient in CMS, news analytics tools, social media platforms, video and photo databases
  • Skilled in navigating government, public records, and archival databases

Attention To Detail

  • Sharp and highly experienced news judgment
  • Meticulous in handling and publishing editorial content
  • Diligent in producing accurate, timely, well reported, vetted, and sourced news content

Organizational Skills

  • Effectively manage time to meet project deadlines
  • Handle multiple tasks and adjust priorities based on project needs

Analytical Thinking

  • Offer solutions to editorial and organizational challenges
  • Adhere to newsroom best practices

Communication Skills

  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication
  • Provide instructions and feedback to students or junior staff

Collaborative Skills

  • Work well within a team and contribute to group projects
  • Ability to “manage up” with higher level leadership

Adaptability

  • Flexibly adapt to new technologies and methods.
  • Continuously learn and seek professional development
  • Handle multiple tasks and adjust priorities as needed

Project Management

  • Oversee content from inception to completion
  • Track progress and report on outcomes

Minimum Requirements

  • Based in the Washington D.C. metro area.
  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in journalism
  • Minimum one year of journalism experience (including internships, on campus publications, and/or freelance work)
  • Demonstrated reporting on race and justice editorial content
  • Demonstrated ability to participate on teams of varied sizes–including those that include freelancers/contributors
  • Demonstrated experience in directly producing breaking news content
  • Knowledge of digital publishing protocols and analytics
  • Experience with CMS and digital editing software
  • Strong attention to detail and organization accuracy with recordkeeping
  • Troubleshooting and problem solving expertise
  • Demonstrated initiative to work self‑directed yet with a collaborative style
  • Strong verbal and written communications skills

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary: $55,000

Compensation Range: $50,000 - $55,000

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos (Business Partner)
description:
1. COMO É SER ANALISTA DE RECURSOS HUMANOS EM MSF-BRASIL?

Você irá atuar como referência generalista de RH, integrando estratégia de pessoas, cultura organizacional, engajamento e excelência operacional. Além disso, irá apoiar diretamente a Gerência de RH em decisões estratégicas, promover a experiência da pessoa funcionária ao longo de toda a jornada e assegurar coerência entre políticas, práticas e valores de MSF.

Contribuir ativamente para que as entregas de RH generalista com sejam orquestradas com efetividade, navegando com fluidez entre os diferentes temas, garantindo consistência, coerência e alinhamento entre as entregas de RH, de modo que se conectem e reforcem mutuamente.

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Integrar a jornada da pessoa funcionária de ponta a ponta, gerando consistência entre os processos e práticas de RH, promovendo melhorias contínuas nos pontos de contato e reforçando o senso de pertencimento, garantindo consistência técnica e cultural desde o onboarding até o offboarding;
  • Ser referência em Cultura & Engajamento, orientando intervenções relacionadas à gestão de clima organizacional de forma efetiva, guiadas por dados e alinhadas aos princípios e valores da organização;
  • Elevar o posicionamento de MSF como empregadora competitiva no Brasil, alinhando comunicação, ações, eventos e conteúdos internos e externos para fortalecer a marca empregadora de forma efetiva e ampliar o alcance a novos talentos;
  • Contribuir para a maturidade analítica do RH, suportando e adotando tomadas de decisão baseadas em dados em todos os subsistemas de RH, a partir da integração de diferentes indicadores (clima, engajamento, rotatividade, eficiência e experiência da pessoa funcionária) à rotina.

3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Cultura Organizacional, Experiência & Engajamento da Pessoa Funcionária

  • Mapear e aprimorar a jornada da pessoa funcionária, identificando os pontos de contato-chave (ex.: onboarding, avaliações de desempenho) para promover o senso de pertencimento e uma experiência positiva;
  • Desenvolver e monitorar métricas de satisfação e engajamento, estruturando pesquisas de satisfação nos pontos de contato e propondo melhorias contínuas nos processos de integração cultural, em parceria com os pares da área;
  • Implementar e apoiar a construção da Pesquisa de Clima, participando ativamente da construção de um plano de ação para fortalecer o engajamento e a experiência organizacional, desde a metodologia à facilitação de planos de ação junto às áreas, monitorando o termômetro organizacional através de métricas de satisfação (eNPS) e suportando tomadas de decisões que fortaleçam o senso de pertencimento e os valores de MSF;
  • Planejar e executar um cronograma anual de ações internas e de reconhecimento e valorização das pessoas funcionárias, promovidas pelo RH (datas comemorativas, eventos de RH, iniciativas de engajamento, brindes etc), em colaboração com Comunicação Interna e Diversidade, observando métricas sobre participação e engajamento.
  • Participar ativamente da criação de materiais normativos (manuais, guias de conduta e ética) em parceria com outras áreas sempre que necessário;

Marca empregadora e atração de talentos

  • Propor ações para posicionar MSF como uma marca empregadora no Brasil, alinhando iniciativas internas e externas com os valores e objetivos da organização, em constante troca com a área e colaboração com Experiência de Marca;
  • Mapear eventos de empregabilidade (feiras, congressos, entre outros) e representar a organização, liderando a preparação, execução e mensuração de resultados dessas ações;
  • Colaborar com as posições digitais para inclusão de temas de empregabilidade em MSF em mídias sociais e criação de campanhas, quando necessário, com o devido acompanhamento de métricas;
  • Apoiar os departamentos de RHN, RHI e Operações (quando necessário) no planejamento e execução de ações para atração de talentos e garantir consistência nas práticas e mensagens passada às pessoas candidatas;
  • Propor melhorias para a página “Trabalhe Conosco”, em alinhamento com RHI, F2F e Operações e em colaboração com as posições digitais;
  • Monitorar a percepção do público e ex-funcionários sobre MSF enquanto marca empregadora, acompanhando sites de opinião e propondo ações corretivas sempre que necessário;

Eficiência Operacional e Inovação

  • Consolidar dados, acompanhar e propor melhorias a KPIs estratégicos de RH (engajamento, rotatividade, clima organizacional, adesão a treinamentos, entre outros);
  • Em parceria e alinhamento com a equipe, gerar relatórios gerenciais com análises qualitativas e quantitativas, fornecendo insights que suportem a tomada de decisão da liderança;
  • Sempre que necessário, mapear e documentar processos de RH, garantindo clareza e alinhamento com as políticas organizacionais, além de apoiar a revisão periódica das políticas, propondo melhorias com foco em transparência, equidade e fortalecimento de MSF como um empregador responsável;
  • Em conjunto com a gestão, identificar e propor melhorias em processos e iniciativas de RH com base em feedbacks de pessoas funcionárias e nos resultados de indicadores de desempenho;
  • Monitorar tendências e realizar benchmarks de mercado para identificar soluções que melhorem a eficiência do departamento e a satisfação das pessoas funcionárias;
  • Administrar a documentação de RH em plataformas digitais de conhecimento institucional, como Click Compliance e Edunuvem, promovendo o uso eficiente das ferramentas internas;
  • Colaborar estrategicamente em projetos do departamento, fornecendo expertise para fortalecer a experiência da pessoa funcionária;

Comunicação de RH

  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento e execução da estratégia de Comunicação Interna, promovendo alinhamento com os valores de MSF, a fim de fortalecer o engajamento organizacional;
  • Em parceria com a Comunicação Interna, apoiar a formação de representantes de marca e embaixadores internos, assegurando a comunicação efetiva e alinhada à cultura organizacional.

4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Graduação completa na área de Recursos Humanos, Administração, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas afins
  • Experiência em posição Generalista de RH ou Business Partner, com vivência em projetos de Cultura e People Analytic
  • Ter domínio do português e inglês avançado
  • Conhecimentos de Pacote Office e comunicação oral e escrita
  • Conhecimentos básicos de legislação trabalhista

5. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES?

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can thrive in a fast-paced environment developing complex applications to join our cutting-edge engineering team. Our ideal candidate would demonstrate an understanding of software development concepts and development lifecycles using Agile methodologies, object-oriented design, and accepted design patterns and practices. You'll be responsible for assisting with system design, coding, improving application performance, collaborating with other developers, and assisting with testing.

  • Lead and supervise the development team, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, aligned with Agile methodologies, and meet quality standards.
  • Design, implement, and deliver highly scalable solutions based on modern cloud-based architecture.
  • Continuously develop, release, monitor, and improve our systems and services while fostering a culture of accountability within the team.
  • Set and actively promote software development processes and best practices, providing mentorship to team members.
  • Participate in and facilitate Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives, to ensure alignment and progress tracking.
  • Provide regular status updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and clear communication of progress, roadblocks, and timelines.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers across the organization to shape high-impact solutions and deliver high-quality applications.
  • Take responsibility for the team’s deliverables, ensuring scope is maintained and work is delivered iteratively while embracing Agile principles.

Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in Node.js , with experience building scalable and efficient backend systems and APIs.
  • SQL and familiarity with relational databases like Oracle or similar platforms.
  • Experience with modern front-end frameworks, specifically React or Angular , and familiarity with Bootstrap for UI development.
  • Exposure to additional languages and frameworks such as PL/SQL, Java/JSP, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, Ruby, and ColdFusion is beneficial but not mandatory.
  • Proficient with source control tools like Git for collaborative development and versioning.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and familiarity with standards like OWASP Top Ten and SANS CWE , with a commitment to adapting to evolving security threats through audits and ongoing education.
  • Team-oriented with exceptional collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional multitasking abilities , capable of balancing multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • An analytical mindset with superior problem-solving abilities and a strong inclination to learn and implement new techniques.
  • Familiarity with mobile-first development and responsive design is a plus.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and coding tools that improve development velocity and software quality.
  • Ability to apply AI across the Node.js lifecycle, including implementation, refactoring, debugging, and unit/integration test creation.
  • Experience using AI to strengthen CI/CD and quality engineering practices (test generation, flaky test analysis, release validation, and review support).
  • Proven ability to design or integrate automation that increases team efficiency, reduces repetitive work, and improves delivery consistency.
  • Practical understanding of model selection, prompt strategy, output validation, and safe handling of proprietary or sensitive information.
  • Evidence of measurable outcomes from AI-enabled engineering (faster delivery cycles, stronger test posture, and reduced production defects).

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English

title: Analista SRE/DevOps
description:
Quem somos?

A Incentive.me é uma plataforma tecnológica de engajamento da força de vendas que permite alcançar um novo patamar na Gestão de Incentivos. Conectamos empresas avendedores ao longo de toda a cadeia, até a ponta no varejo, criando campanhas de incentivo eficazes que transformam comportamentos e aumentam as vendas. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar uma cultura voltada para performance e resultados.

Quem procuramos?

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar com SRE/DevOps, apoiando a operação, evolução e automação dos nossos ambientes e serviços. Procuramos alguém com boa base técnica, raciocínio lógico, curiosidade real e vontade de aprender constantemente. Mais do que alguém que apenas siga tutoriais, buscamos uma pessoa que goste de entender como as tecnologias funcionam na prática, saiba investigar problemas e tenha maturidade para evoluir com autonomia. Você vai atuar em temas como cloud, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observabilidade, troubleshooting, documentação técnica e boas práticas de segurança.

O que você vai fazer?

  • Apoiar a sustentação e a evolução dos ambientes e serviços
  • Atuar com monitoramento, observabilidade e troubleshooting
  • Apoiar a resposta a incidentes, troubleshooting, Disaster recovery, e RCA
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD e automações operacionais
  • Apoiar a operação de workloads em Kubernetes e serviços em cloud
  • Colaborar com times técnicos para melhorar confiabilidade, disponibilidade e eficiência operacional
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica de ambientes, processos e mudanças
  • Apoiar boas práticas de segurança em infraestrutura, acessos, pipelines e aplicações
  • Participar de análises de causa raiz(RCA)

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Base sólida em Linux/Unix e uso de terminal/CLI no dia a dia
  • Conhecimento sólido de redes e internet, como IP, sub-rede, DNS, HTTP e OSI
  • Security by design na prática
  • Contato com Kubernetes na prática
  • Experiência com ArgoCD, Helm, Helmfile e manifestos YAML puros.
  • Capacidade de troubleshooting avançado de serviços e rede
  • Entendimento sobre protocolos diversos como DNS, HTTPS, TLS e SSH
  • Experiência prática com Docker, Dockerfile e Docker Compose
  • Conhecimento dos principais objetos do Kubernetes
  • Contato prático com Git e GitHub Actions
  • Noções de CI/CD
  • Contato com observabilidade com ferramentas como Grafana e PrometheusExperiência com IaC e automações
  • Capacidade de automatizar tarefas com scripts e linguagens de programação
  • Boa capacidade de investigação e correlação de problemas

Conhecimentos relevantes

  • Entendimento prático de DNS, proxy reverso, CDN, cache e WAF
  • Conhecimentos sobre Cloud, GCP, AWS, Azure e seus principais serviços e conceitos
  • Familiaridade com serviços gerenciados em cloud
  • Conhecimentos sobre gerenciamento de acesso com IAM, RBAC, SA e controle de acesso
  • Conhecimento de APM ou ferramentas equivalentes
  • Familiaridade com Cloudflare
  • Familiaridade com GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI
  • Conhecimento prático do modelo OSI
  • Noções de segurança aplicadas à infraestrutura e às aplicações
  • Entendimento de conceitos de segurança como CVE, RCE, ransomware, reverse shell, pentest e SQLi

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prática com GCP em produção
  • Experiência com GKE
  • Experiência com IAM e Cloud Monitoring na prática
  • Experiência com Cloudflare em ambiente real
  • Experiência com Kubernetes gerenciado ou self-hosted em produção
  • Experiência com Terraform, OpenTofu ou Ansible
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD em ambientes reais
  • Experiência com observabilidade usando Grafana e Prometheus
  • Experiência com disaster recovery, post-mortem, SLA, SLI e SLO
  • Noções ou experiência prática em DevSecOps
  • Vivência em provedores, operadoras, datacenter ou ambientes de infraestrutura de TI
  • Certificações relevantes em cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps ou segurança

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios adicionais: plano de saúde, vale-refeição, vale-transporte e auxílio
  • Home-Office
